# CodingBhai

> CodingBhai is an online coding platform for learning programming, solving DSA problems, debugging code with AI, and preparing for technical interviews.

CodingBhai helps developers practice coding, track progress, and improve their programming skills.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://codingbhai.online/): Overview of the CodingBhai coding platform.
- [Problems](https://codingbhai.online/problems): Practice coding and data structures and algorithms problems.
- [Leaderboard](https://codingbhai.online/leaderboard): View coding rankings and platform progress.
- [Learn](https://codingbhai.online/learn): Explore programming learning resources.
- [Interview Preparation](https://codingbhai.online/interview): Practice technical interview questions.
- [Login](https://codingbhai.online/login): Sign in to a CodingBhai account.
- [Sign Up](https://codingbhai.online/signup): Create a CodingBhai account.

## Platform Information

- [Sitemap](https://codingbhai.online/sitemap.xml): Discover public website URLs.
- [Robots.txt](https://codingbhai.online/robots.txt): Review crawler access rules.

## Important Notes

CodingBhai provides coding practice and educational resources. Do not assume that private dashboards, user profiles, submissions, or administrative pages are publicly accessible.
